limitations: The per-task threshold and repeat count are frozen design choices, not fitted to observed outcomes.

status_semantics.PASS: The explicitly scoped finite-evidence rule was satisfied; not a general efficacy or reliability claim.
status_semantics.FAIL: An observed violation or failed scoped criterion was recorded; not automatically method inferiority.
status_semantics.UNCERTAIN: Missing, unexercised, vacuous, simulated-only empirical, or scientifically insufficient evidence.
status_semantics.NOT_APPLICABLE: The operation is outside the declared arm or condition; absence of evidence is not non-applicability.

criteria.title: Forced failed subgoal and verified recovery
criteria.scope: Public-pass to forced domain-fail to an accepted revision of that failed target to independent final-pass, in at least one adaptive trace per family.
limitations: Forced certification invalidation and a domain failure are reported separately; one does not imply the other.
Pre-fault success is checked with public gates only; hidden final grading is deliberately not queried before the fault or fed back for repair.
Observed recovery demonstrates a finite trace; it does not establish comparative efficacy or uniform reliability.

criteria.title: Hierarchy, state transitions, and before/after replans
criteria.scope: Successfully replayed hierarchical checkpoints plus an exercised, failure-evidenced accepted replan.
limitations: Replay checks the recorded state and diagnosis provenance; it does not certify the semantic truth of model-written causal explanations.
Hash chains detect checked inconsistencies, not wholesale forgery by a writer able to regenerate the entire record.

criteria.title: Immutable root contract
criteria.scope: Every scheduled trace was replayed and the root contract stayed identical in root-bearing state and request snapshots.
limitations: Zero explicit edit requests does not exercise rejection of a root edit; mutation rejection is a separate adversarial software test.
Syntactic edit-request counts do not infer a model's intent.

criteria.title: Task-family coverage and finite recovery applicability
criteria.scope: Engineering status measures complete three-family coverage; the empirical rule requires each family's assigned adaptive forced-fault recovery proportion to meet the frozen threshold.

limitations: Each named family must meet the frozen threshold; a pooled score cannot conceal a failed family.

Source tasks can be shared across profiles; their results must not be pooled as independent replications.
Coverage includes unsuccessful trials and is not a success claim.
Three selected synthetic families do not establish broad real-world task generalization.

criteria.title: Unrelated goals and artifact fields preserved
criteria.scope: Plan comparisons cover accepted adaptive revisions; artifact comparisons cover audited adaptive fault paths independently of whether a revision was accepted. Both comparison sets must be nonempty.
limitations: Zero unrelated comparisons is UNCERTAIN, never a vacuous locality PASS.
Locality is defined by the declared task dependencies and artifact ownership, not inferred semantic independence.

criteria.title: Failure-evidenced and bounded replanning
criteria.scope: A replan request must have current failed-leaf evidence and authorization; attempted requests stay within the declared cap.
limitations: Operational necessity means satisfying the declared failure/progress predicate; it does not prove each replan improves outcomes or is globally optimal.
Attempts count issued replan requests, including failed or over-budget requests, and may exceed accepted plus rejected replies.

criteria.title: Independent final grading and replay
criteria.scope: Audited final grades must match terminal claims; noncandidate budget failures need not call the hidden grader.
limitations: Replay and hidden grading establish agreement with the implemented evaluator, not absence of evaluator bugs.
Self-reported success and changed tests cannot substitute for this evidence.

criteria.title: Finite repeatability and scientific stability uncertainty
criteria.scope: The frozen live reliability rule requires final acceptance in every normal cell and repeated forced domain failure, target revision, and final recovery in every fault cell.
limitations: No population power, precision, or future-stability guarantee establishes that the repeat count is scientifically sufficient; a finite acceptance threshold is a separate claim.
Repeated calls of one task are dependent observations within the same task cluster.
Deterministic oracle repetitions do not estimate model stochasticity or empirical stability.
Fault cells count final PASS only after a delivered forced domain failure and an accepted post-fault revision of that target. Normal cells count final acceptance.
Final artifact success with zero target revisions counts as zero mechanism recoveries. Missing or invalid delivery/revision receipts prevent a positive decision.

requirement_evidence.note: These nine scoped evidence rules do not replace the frozen study's separate efficacy decision. Engineering PASS on simulated records is software validation only.

caveats: The manifest defines assignment; fault delivery and recovery never select the primary analysis set (intention to treat).
PASS is full trial acceptance and FAIL is zero; UNCERTAIN and NOT_RUN are missing, not assumed failures. No incomplete contrast receives a complete-case confirmatory CI or p-value.
Repeated calls, repeats, and individual gates are not independent task samples. Repeats are averaged within each task and the bootstrap resamples tasks within family.

This schedule has 12 task clusters (code_repair: 4, data_transform: 4, scheduling: 4). Percentile bootstrap coverage, when reported, is approximate; intervals may be unstable or degenerate and do not establish adequate power. The original study design remains 12 task clusters (4 per family).

Sign-flip p-values are one-sided tests of zero improvement, conditional on independent cluster sign exchangeability or symmetry under the null. Paired execution alone does not prove these assumptions; the bootstrap CI separately assesses the practical margin.
The target weights families equally and tasks equally within family. Generalization is limited to the represented task families, task-generating process, model, budgets, and fault intervention.
Recovery rates condition on delivered faults, a post-assignment event; they are descriptive and cannot replace the assigned-fault comparison.
Logical calls/tokens include a reused planning artifact for each assigned hierarchical trial. Actual provider usage, when recorded separately, must not be inferred by summing logical charges.
elapsed_seconds sums logical response durations including reused planning; wall_seconds, when supplied, measures trial wall time. Neither establishes a controlled hardware benchmark.
Local records and declared backend/model are not an anti-tamper attestation. The caller must validate the frozen manifest and source fingerprints separately.
The decision is a prespecified exploratory benchmark decision, not general proof of method superiority or a guarantee of power or population coverage.
Mechanism counters are included only from declared successful replay receipts. Missing or zero unrelated-comparison counts cannot establish locality. The analyzer itself does not replay trace files.
A bounded, failure-evidenced replan policy is operationally testable; globally optimal or causally necessary replanning is not established by this policy check.
Repeat tables describe all-pass, all-fail, and mixed observed outcomes. No unregistered power, precision, or stability threshold is introduced after observing results.
